selection.freshnessScope: 94 pinned prior inventories; not a claim about unknown human exposure

limitations: Direct fixed file-runtime quality confirmation only; no paced Stop latency, p95, speed, energy, RAM or overall product qualification.
Eight new source recordings plus four fixed-gain variants, not twelve independent recordings. Freshness means absent from the 94 pinned known earlier input inventories.
Both arms reproduce the same existing WER errors; equality does not mean error-free transcription.

Source archive verification and F32-to-PCM16 extraction followed the frozen preparer before ASR; no large archives, models, binaries or kernel blobs rehashed in this independent readback. Model/binary/kernel retention checked against prior accepted quality100 immutable fingerprints.
Filesystem times support observed ordering and are not a trusted cryptographic timestamp. No claim that a human never saw the source texts.
256MiB is an installed reusable-cache policy; this run exports no active/cache/RSS samples and proves no 256MiB total-memory ceiling.
